transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I guess… I’m here because I feel like I’m always running hot. Like I can’t shut the motor off. And lately it’s been starting to cause problems at the firehouse.
Have you had times when you felt unusually energized or up, more than your normal self?
I don’t know… I mean, I’m kind of always wound up, so it’s hard to tell what’s “more than normal.” I wouldn’t say I’ve noticed feeling unusually up, exactly.
When you’re feeling especially wound up, do you need less sleep than usual?
Not really sure. I mean, my sleep’s not great sometimes, but I don’t know that I need less of it… I still feel it when I don’t get enough.
Have you felt this constantly wound up way since you were a kid?

Yeah… I think so. My mom says I was like this back in grade school too. Always out of my seat, blurting stuff out, losing homework… notes getting sent home. She says I was smart enough to do it, I just… didn’t.
Do you still have trouble paying attention when someone is talking to you?

Yeah. That still happens. Like in briefings, or drone training… I’ll be good for the first few minutes, and then I realize I’ve just been staring at the map or the screen and missed a lot of what they said.
Do you spend a lot of your day worrying, even when there isn’t an obvious reason to?
I don’t know… not really for no reason. I mean, I worry when there’s something going on, sure. But I wouldn’t say it’s most of the day or anything.
Do these attention problems cause trouble for you at work now?

Yeah… it is. I don’t really like saying that, but it’s started costing me trust at the firehouse. I got pulled into a performance and safety meeting over it, and now it feels like my chance at moving into leadership is kind of slipping because the crew can’t always count on me to track the details.
Have you ever had a distinct period where you felt unusually euphoric or unusually irritable for days at a time?
No… I don’t think so. I get irritated like anybody, especially under stress, but not some stretch of days where I felt unusually up or out of character.
